description: Enterprise Indonesian regulatory compliance and multi-tenant policy studio. Combines Hybrid Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) retrieval across official national regulations (PP No. 35/2021, PP No. 36/2021, UU PDP No. 27/2022) and isolated company workspaces, zero-quota local document upload, automated contract/SOP redlining with full compliant document generation, and a deterministic statutory calculator & official HR/Legal letter generator.
description_id: Platform kepatuhan regulasi dan kebijakan korporat multi-perusahaan (Multi-Tenant) berbahasa Indonesia. Menggabungkan Hybrid Retrieval (RRF) di atas korpus regulasi resmi RI (PP No. 35/2021 Ketenagakerjaan, PP No. 36/2021 Pengupahan, UU No. 27/2022 PDP) dan workspace perusahaan terisolasi, fitur upload dokumen mandiri tanpa kuota API, audit otomatis & penyusunan ulang dokumen kontrak/SOP (Auto-Redliner), serta kalkulator hukum deterministik & generator surat resmi HR/Legal siap cetak.
description_en: Enterprise Indonesian regulatory compliance and multi-tenant policy studio. Combines Hybrid Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) retrieval across official national regulations (PP No. 35/2021, PP No. 36/2021, UU PDP No. 27/2022) and isolated company workspaces, zero-quota local document upload, automated contract/SOP redlining with full compliant document generation, and a deterministic statutory calculator & official HR/Legal letter generator.
architecture_id:
1. Multi-Tenant Hybrid Retrieval (RRF) & Zero-Quota Local Ingestion

  • 5 Workspace Terisolasi: Mencakup korpus pasal resmi PP No. 35/2021 & PP No. 36/2021 (Ketenagakerjaan), UU No. 27/2022 (UU PDP), 12 SOP Internal Perusahaan, serta Custom Company Tenant di mana pengunjung dapat mengunggah file .pdf/.md/.txt sendiri.
  • Zero-Quota Ingestion: Ekstraksi teks dan pemotongan pasal dilakukan secara lokal tanpa memakan kuota API LLM.
  • Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF k=60): Menggabungkan pencarian leksikal dan semantik dengan Safe Refusal Guardrail untuk mencegah halusinasi.

2. Smart Policy Auditor, Auto-Redliner & Statutory Letter Generator

  • Automated Redlining & Rewrite: Memindai draf kontrak PKWT/SOP terhadap pasal wajib PP 35/2021 & UU PDP, menampilkan Redline Diff, dan otomatis men-generate dokumen revisi utuh siap unduh/cetak.
  • Deterministic Statutory Calculator: Menghitung uang kompensasi PKWT, lembur (1/173 upah sebulan), pesangon PHK (Pasal 40-57 PP 35/2021), dan denda/tenggat 3x24 jam UU PDP secara deterministik, lalu men-generate draf surat resmi perusahaan.
architecture_en:
1. Multi-Tenant Hybrid Retrieval (RRF) & Zero-Quota Local Ingestion

  • 5 Isolated Workspaces: Covers verbatim clauses from PP No. 35/2021 & PP No. 36/2021 (Labor Law), UU No. 27/2022 (UU PDP Data Privacy), 12 Internal Corporate SOPs, plus a Custom Company Tenant where visitors can upload their own .pdf/.md/.txt files.
  • Zero-Quota Ingestion: Clause segmentation and text extraction run locally with zero LLM API quota consumption.
  • Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF k=60): Fuses lexical and semantic rankings with a strict Safe Refusal Guardrail.

2. Smart Policy Auditor, Auto-Redliner & Statutory Letter Generator

  • Automated Redlining & Rewrite: Audits draft contracts/SOPs against mandatory articles of PP 35/2021 & UU PDP, displays side-by-side redline diffs, and automatically generates a complete compliant replacement document.
  • Deterministic Statutory Calculator: Computes PKWT compensation, overtime (1/173 monthly wage), PHK severance multipliers, and 3x24h UU PDP breach notices deterministically, outputting ready-to-print corporate letters.

blueprint.function_id: Pilih Workspace (PP 35/2021, UU PDP 27/2022, atau Upload Dokumen Perusahaan Sendiri) -> Hybrid RRF Retrieval / Audit Draf Kontrak / Kalkulator Rumus Pasal Deterministik -> Jawaban Bersitasi Resmi + Dokumen Kontrak Hasil Revisi Otomatis + Surat Resmi HR/Legal Siap Cetak.
blueprint.function_en: Select Tenant Workspace (PP 35/2021, UU PDP 27/2022, or Custom Uploaded Company Docs) -> Hybrid RRF Retrieval / Contract Draft Audit / Deterministic Statutory Calculator -> Cited Answer + Auto-Rewritten Compliant Document + Printable Official Corporate Letter.
blueprint.utility_id: Mengubah proses review kontrak, pencarian regulasi ketenagakerjaan/UU PDP, dan pembuatan surat resmi HR dari berjam-jam menjadi <10 detik, dengan penghematan 100% kuota API pada tahap ingesti dokumen lokal.
blueprint.utility_en: Transforms contract compliance auditing, Indonesian labor/privacy law lookup, and official HR letter drafting from hours into <10 seconds, with 100% API quota savings during local document ingestion.
blueprint.target_id: Divisi HR, Legal & Compliance, Data Protection Officer (DPO), Pemilik Bisnis/UMKM, dan Karyawan di Indonesia.
blueprint.target_en: HR divisions, Legal & Compliance teams, Data Protection Officers (DPO), Business Owners, and Employees in Indonesia.
layman_proof_id: Audit Draf & Auto-Generate Dokumen Revisi: Klik 1 tombol contoh draf kontrak PKWT bermasalah -> sistem langsung menandai pasal yang melanggar PP 35/2021 dan men-generate dokumen kontrak baru yang sudah 100% diperbaiki.

Kalkulator Hukum & Generator Surat Resmi: Masukkan gaji & masa kerja -> sistem menghitung nominal rupiah pesangon/kompensasi PKWT secara pasti (tanpa halusinasi) dan membuatkan Surat Resmi HR siap cetak PDF.
Upload Dokumen Perusahaan Sendiri (Multi-Tenant): Buat workspace perusahaan Anda sendiri, unggah file dokumen (.md/.txt/.pdf), dan langsung tanyakan isinya di Copilot.
layman_proof_en: 1-Click Audit & Auto-Rewrite Deliverable: Load a non-compliant PKWT contract draft -> the system flags violations against PP 35/2021 and generates a complete, law-compliant replacement document ready for download.
Deterministic Statutory Calculator & Official Letter: Enter salary & tenure -> computes exact IDR severance/compensation via statutory formulas and generates a printable official HR notice.
Custom Multi-Tenant Document Upload: Create an isolated company workspace, upload your own policy files (0 API quota cost), and query them immediately.
